scripts.docs: cd docs && bundle exec jekyll serve
scripts.lint: bun scripts/tool.ts biome check --config-path=. && bun scripts/tool.ts tombi format --check && bun scripts/tool.ts tombi lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun scripts/tool.ts biome check --config-path=. --write --unsafe && bun scripts/tool.ts tombi format && bun scripts/tool.ts tombi lint --error-on-warnings
scripts.lint:fix:safe: bun scripts/tool.ts biome check --config-path=. --write && bun scripts/tool.ts tombi format && bun scripts/tool.ts tombi lint --error-on-warnings
scripts.test:tz: for tz in Asia/Tokyo America/Los_Angeles Pacific/Kiritimati; do TZ=$tz bun test apps/api/tests/integration/timezone.test.ts apps/api/tests/integration/stats.test.ts apps/api/tests/integration/pg-store.test.ts packages/shared/tests/time.test.ts packages/nasi/tests/tools/current-time.test.ts apps/web/src/lib/period.test.ts apps/tui/tests/lib/session/store.test.ts || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck: set -e; for pkg in apps/* apps/*/* packages/* .claude/skills scripts; do [ -f "$pkg/tsconfig.json" ] || continue; (cd "$pkg" && bunx tsc --noEmit); done
